svg.text: Source dimensions and power: implemented prototype. ALL interior allocations: PROPOSED.
Bounds are rectangular reservations, NOT an accurate hull silhouette or production CAD.
TOP ENVELOPE: 640 m x 260 m / +X forward →
SIDE ENVELOPE / same scale: 640 m x 180 m
GAME POWER: 900,000 J charge | 3,000 W regeneration | 90,000 J warp | 9,000 J mining cycle
CARGO: 8,000 game units. No volume/mass conversion defined. Mining module IDs: 0, 1.
Power physical route (PROPOSED): power reserve → charge store → isolated bus → warp / turrets / drones.
Avatar: 1.8 m tall, 0.6 m existing collision diameter. Proposed door: 1.4 x 2.4 m; corridor: 2.4 m.
Room clear height: 3.2 m; deck pitch: 3.8 m. Vertical access/airlocks/life support are not implemented.
